name: Media Production State and Streaming Criteria
description: Requires durable artifact, job, and stream lifecycle with object-store integrity, governed and concurrency-safe byte deduplication, restart-safe state, bounded backpressure, and production provider security.

criteria.description: S3/PostgreSQL providers must prove sequential resumable chunks, expected-size enforcement, SHA-256 completion, encrypted final objects, tenant-scoped byte reuse only when file name, content type, classification, metadata, and retention are compatible, savepoint reconciliation of concurrent compatible unique-key races, idempotent jobs, stream token/lease ownership, contiguous frames, and terminal transitions.
Remote processing and streaming providers must be inert when unconfigured and require HTTPS plus typed credentials for production eligibility.

acceptanceCriteria.pass: Artifact, governed concurrent deduplication, job, stream, reconnect, backpressure, and provider-security tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria.fail: Any size, checksum, encryption, tenant, metadata compatibility, retention, concurrent uniqueness, idempotency, token, lease, sequence, backpressure, credential, or HTTPS invariant fails.
acceptanceCriteria.reviewGate: The ghatana-lifecycle Evidence Generator owns the canonical results and gate decision.
